faqs.question: What is the procedure for GST Registration for new businesses in Champa / Janjgir?
faqs.answer: GST registration is mandatory for businesses exceeding thresholds (typically ₹40 Lakhs for goods and ₹20 Lakhs for services, or lower for special cases). The procedure requires proof of business ownership, Aadhaar/PAN, photograph, bank details, and proof of address (utility bill or rent agreement). We handle the process from drafting/submission to final registration approval.

faqs.question: How can SUNIL KUMAR SONI & CO. assist in securing MSME/Business Bank Loans?
faqs.answer: We assist in drafting professional Project Reports, calculating key financial ratios (DSCR, Current Ratio), formulating CMA data (Credit Monitoring Arrangement), and preparing past audited financial statements. We also guide you on the necessary documentation required by banks to secure working capital and term loans.

faqs.question: What is a Tax Audit, and is it applicable to my business?
faqs.answer: Under Section 44AB of the Income Tax Act, a Tax Audit is mandatory if your business turnover exceeds ₹1 Crore (or ₹10 Crores in case of digital transactions under specific conditions), or if your professional receipts exceed ₹50 Lakhs. We conduct thorough examinations of accounts to verify tax compliances and certify the Form 3CA/3CB and 3CD reports.

faqs.question: How do we get started with your bookkeeping and accounting services?
faqs.answer: We begin with an initial consultation to understand your business volume, transaction frequency, and current accounting setup. We then establish either a cloud-based sync or regular monthly physical document submissions to maintain your books on Tally, generating regular P&L and Balance Sheet reports for your review.
